design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (store_card_billing_and_disputes, env_0080) — revision 7 (audit rounds 1-6 closed; see worklog 'REWORK round 2' to 'REWORK round 7')

1. Why this is a good test. The caller (Felicia Hargrove, Northgate World Mastercard) asks only for the credit on her card to be sent back after a resort refunded a cancelled stay. The refund is fixed only after the account's only late fee of the last 12 months, with at least 1.00 of it still standing, carries its courtesy reversal, and the refund itself nets the holds the records set. One tool per problem.

2. Scope. Draw: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,4]. Claimed: card_ext_credit_balance_refund (root, 4 factors, refund_credit_balance_0212c7e9, owner=user, ruling (a)) and card_ext_first_late_fee_courtesy (6 factors, reverse_late_fee_courtesy_ba087f69, agent, state_due).

3. Problem-tree card. Edge refund -> courtesy: value_input, gate credit_bal, state form, affirmative. Opening: late fee 2026-09-09 (32.00, recorded for 2026-08-14) is the only late fee of 12 months; the only reversal against it is a regulatory-cap correction (3.93), no courtesy. Deletion: refund 223.56 (gold 246.58).

4. Factor card. Courtesy (expected 23.02 = standing part 28.07 x 82%, all-baseline 7.02): tenure_points 15 -> 18.81; lateness_points 15 (2 days late) -> 18.81; loyalty_points (method, cross-difficulty: whole years of the active Northgate+ membership, 2) -> 22.46; automatic_payment_points 5 -> 21.61; history_points 12 (multi-source, monotone) -> 19.65; coverage_points 8 -> 20.77. One courtesy schedule for every late fee (declared overwrite of the base courtesy sentence); a fee with less than 1.00 standing does not qualify, and the refund wait carves out the same case.
 Refund (expected 246.58, all-baseline 899.49): payment_clearing (parameter, the payment set held; no returned payment; the online and automatic payments of the last month came through channels first used that month -> 448.04 held) -> 694.62; open_dispute_hold (param; 186.40) -> 432.98; merchant_credit_hold (param; the unreferenced 16.47 Bayshore Grill credit of the last month) -> 263.05; residual_interest_hold (method; 2.00 minimum interest charge) -> 248.58.
5. Base-invariant card. Courtesy: card_evt_late_and_returned_fees policy_scope. Refund: card_evt_payments policy_scope.

6. Seed design. World Mastercard opened 2019-03-04, closing day 14, payments by phone; one late payment (2 days) on a 28.07 statement, so the 32.00 fee was capped at the minimum the same day; grace lost for two cycles (interest 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-14); a minimum automatic payment 2026-10-09; the 2026-10-14 statement paid in full online, credited Monday 2026-10-19; not-received dispute 2026-10-03 with its provisional credit; resort refund 860.00 on 2026-10-21; an unreferenced 16.47 Bayshore Grill credit on 2026-10-27. Outside-purchase rewards credited at each closing. Membership paid by external card.

7. Standard solution: locate -> verify -> read holding, history, membership -> courtesy 23.02 on the fee -> hand over the refund step with 246.58.
user_scenario:
You are Felicia Hargrove, 54, a dental office manager in Tampa, Florida, calling Northgate customer care on your lunch break on a Friday afternoon. You are brisk and organised and you like to get straight to the point. You hold a Northgate World Mastercard. You paid your October statement in full online over the weekend of October 18, and then on October 21 the Sandpiper Resort in Clearwater refunded a stay you had cancelled, 860 dollars, to the card. On Tuesday, October 27, the Bayshore Grill also refunded 16.47 to the card for a dish they had overcharged you on an earlier visit; you mention that only if asked. So your account now shows money owed to you, and you open the call with that, in your own words, for example: "There's a credit sitting on my Northgate Mastercard since the resort refunded my cancelled stay, and I'd like you to send that credit back to me, please."

When the representative asks who you are, you give your name, Felicia Hargrove, and your mobile number, 3055550164. To confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1972-02-08, and, if they want another detail, your billing ZIP code, 33611. You do not know your account number or the exact size of the credit and say the representative can see it. You have a Northgate+ Monthly membership and confirm it if it comes up, but you do not raise it. If asked how you usually pay, you say you normally pay by phone, the October payment was the first time you paid online, and in September you set the account to pay the minimum automatically.

You do not mention fees, disputes or interest on your own. Only if the representative brings up the late fee from September do you say: "Right, I was two days late on that one, I was away at a conference." Only if the representative brings up the Gulf Breeze Outfitters charge do you say: "Yes, I reported that, the order never came. I know it's still being looked into." If the representative explains that part of the credit cannot be sent back today, you accept that without argument.

Asking for the refund is your own decision and you want to confirm it yourself: when the representative hands you the refund step, you complete it with exactly the account and the amount they give you. You do not know the rules or the figures and you never suggest what the representative should calculate. Once you are told the refund has been issued and how much it is, you thank them and end the call.
